scope: Reference-only diagnosis of the immutable P2E03/P2E04 162-case domain; no production physics, tolerance, reference source, case-set or RossFast change

iteration_budget_test.interpretation: The preregistered domain provides no evidence that the dominant LOCAL_BAL failures are caused primarily by the 16-iteration budget.

residual_scaling_observations.rate_pattern: The mean maximum local residual rate rises as requested coarse dt decreases, most strongly at 0.0001 day.
residual_scaling_observations.integrated_pattern: Multiplying each failed-stage maximum residual rate by its actual failed-stage dt keeps the residual depth on an approximately 1e-16 to 1e-15 cm scale rather than showing the same rate amplification.
residual_scaling_observations.theta_spacing_context: The maximum residual divided by a theta-spacing-derived storage-rate scale remains predominantly order unity. This is context consistent with a numerical representation/cancellation floor, not causal proof of IEEE roundoff.
residual_scaling_observations.max_node_decomposition: The emitted LOCAL_BAL diagnostics report zero final candidate-state storage-rate contribution at the maximum-residual node and assign the observed residual to the algebraic non-storage remainder at that node.
residual_scaling_observations.boundary: Because the residual contains coupled constitutive and flux terms, P2E06 does not attribute the mechanism to one arithmetic operation or one physical term.
